q: In Hosea, what does God desire rather than sacrifice?
quote: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice

q: In Hosea, out of which land did God call His son Israel?
why: God loved Israel as a child.
quote: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.

q: In Hosea, what does the prophet urge Israel to do?
quote: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God

q: In Hosea, God says He led Israel with ropes of what?
quote: I led them with cords of kindness, with ropes of love

q: Whom did the prophet Hosea marry?
why: His marriage pictured God and Israel.
quote: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim

q: In Hosea, God told Hosea to love his wife again as the LORD loves whom?
quote: Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites

q: In Hosea, God desires the knowledge of God rather than what?
quote: and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.

q: In Hosea, what did God lift from His people's necks?
why: He bent down to feed them.
quote: I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down to feed them.

q: Who was the prophet Hosea's father?
quote: the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri

q: In Hosea, Gomer was the daughter of whom?
quote: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim
